caption:
Koko lifted her grandkid and let out a big oof. Is it too late to start strength training?

Muscle and bone keep responding to load throughout life. Research suggests strength training can help with everyday tasks, balance and joint pain, and it's rarely too late to begin.

Start with sit-to-stands, wall push-ups, step-ups, band rows and calf raises. Two 20–30 minute sessions a week, 8–12 reps each, is a great start. A bit of stiffness a day or two later is common.

Chest pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness needs a GP review; a swelling joint or pain that builds needs a program tweak. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios build programs around your goals. Book online via the link in bio 💪
